hard_think: The v2 digest is deterministic integrity under trusted AgentDB/CAS; it is not a MAC or signature against an arbitrary database writer.

SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE precedes claim, start, and completion clock evaluation; PostgreSQL composes FOR UPDATE into each task-row SELECT, while live PostgreSQL contention remains unproven. SQLite crossing-expiry writer-contention regressions fail closed.
An expiry fence at task completion does not cancel an already-running external authority transaction or prove the lease again at every route CAS.
Maintenance freshness RSI restores an exact-main query generation; it cannot propose, independently evaluate, promote, canary, roll back, or learn retrieval changes.
Latest public retrieval metrics are Recall@8 1.0, MRR 0.9167, and nDCG@8 0.8718 against an all-metrics 0.95 floor, so A-grade fails on measured quality as well as authority closure.
dialectic_sweep: Hashing only task content was smaller but allowed claim identity and expiry substitution; complete claim context had to enter one canonical digest.
Rejecting every expired completion would break exact idempotent replay; only a recorded completion at or before expiry may replay afterward.
Extending a namespace generically made tests import but admitted foreign paths; the exact repository-root alias preserves only the intended compatibility seam.
Calling freshness repair full RSI would erase the proposer/evaluator/admission/promotion/canary/rollback/outcome-learning gap; the receipt keeps those states separate.
first_principles: A task starts only with one exact active v2 claim whose assigned time equals issued time and whose duration is in 1..7,500 seconds.
The first completion must cross the AgentDB transaction boundary before expiry; exact replay remains valid only when stored completion preceded expiry.
Controller proof cycles are deterministic, bounded to 0..31, and cannot widen the fixed two-proof controller limit.
Candidate completion is insufficient: rebase, merge, exact-current-main replay, immutable-replica reproof, and clean authority/control checkouts remain required.
